title: SDG 03-3-1: HIV Incidence per 1,000 Uninfected Population
description: Number of new HIV infections per 1,000 uninfected population by sex, as per the specifications of SDG Indicator 3-3-1.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 as the data is at annual frequency.

fields.name: sex
fields.title: Sex
fields.description: [Categorical] Either both sexes ('both'), male ('male') or female ('female')

fields.name: incidence
fields.title: Incidence
fields.description: [Numeric] Number of new HIV infections per 1,000 uninfected population

methodology: This dataset is tabulated from administrative data on the notifications of infectious diseases collected by the Ministry of Health. The total number of new cases per year is subsequently divided by the estimated uninfected population for that year to calculate the incidence rate. Although this data is primarily collected as part of Malaysia's general healthcare operations, it is specifically reported as part of Malaysia's monitoring of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), in line with the most recent [SDG Global Indicator Framework](https://storage.dosm.gov.my/technotes/sdg.pdf).
